title: Caraval
author: Stephanie Garber
description: A magical fantasy adventure where nothing is quite what it seems. Scarlett Dragna has never left her tiny island, but when she receives an invitation to Caraval, a once-a-year performance where the audience participates in the show, she enters a world of magic, mystery, and danger where she must find her sister before the five nights of Caraval are over.
